decisions.reason: The Big Block's distinct sales-count trigger and funding sources are already captured by its same-message MODIFY; the Small Block change requires no additional update.
Changing the Small Block draw condition does not alter the existing per-primary-sale revenue allocations.
The source remains consistent with secondary royalties funding prize pools and does not change the royalty amount, founder allocation, or ticket-generation rule.
The Small Block trigger and funding-source change does not affect the independently stated $15 primary mint price.
The revised Small Block draw condition does not change the one-click prize claim method, Winners page, or claim URL.
The source does not change what transfers with an NFT or the rule that expired tickets remain expired.
The Small Block mechanics change leaves the NFT ebook product type and unlimited primary-mint supply unchanged.
The source preserves the immediate $5 coded-referral commission and does not change its trigger, recipient, timing, or destination.
Changing the Small Block draw trigger does not alter the requirement to expose separate Small Block and Big Block ticket counters in NFT metadata.
The FAQ requirement already adopts the complete Q&A from the same source message, including the revised Small Block explanation.
The Small Block mechanics change does not affect the mint-number referral code's identity, permanence, or display locations.
The revised Small Block trigger does not change fiat users' dashboard access or the wallet requirement for receiving affiliate commissions.
